title: TrustRail Pipelines
summary: Lock input tokens against a min-output commitment, withdraw to a staging account, run a 1:1 mock swap, submit on-chain proof, and release the output to the payer.
what: TrustRail is an Anchor 1.2.0 settlement layer: funds are locked, a swap venue (here mock_swap at a fixed 1:1 rate) produces output, and submit_proof compares the output ATA balance to min_output_amount with no off-chain judge. This lesson covers the Passed path through release.
app_note: The page at /dapps/trustrail-pipelines/ is the generic IDL console pointed at trustrail_pipelines. mock_swap is a separate lab-deployed program used as the swap venue. The hosted IDLs are hand-derived subsets; discriminators were confirmed by the verifying transactions. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/trustrail-pipelines (unique declare_ids).

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/trustrail-pipelines/ on Devnet. The lab already ran create_commitment → withdraw_for_swap → mock_swap_execute → submit_proof → release for 1_000_000 input units.

diagram: payer --create_commitment--> commitment ["commitment", task_id] + escrow/output ATAs ; settler --withdraw_for_swap--> staging (delegated) ; worker --mock_swap_execute--> output_ata ; worker --submit_proof--> Passed ; settler --release--> payer output ATA
accounts: escrow_ata / output_ata (ATAs owned by the commitment)
swap staging token account (delegated to the commitment)
instructions: refund / cancel / recover exist but were not exercised
innovation: Deterministic on-chain outcome verification: submit_proof compares the real output ATA balance to min_output_amount, with no LLM judge.
frontend: Generic Sol.College IDL console for trustrail_pipelines (mock_swap is a separate program).
exercises: Fetch commitment Gu9K13nu… and confirm status is Released.
Explain why the staging account must be delegated to the commitment before withdraw_for_swap.
Sketch the FailedSlippage path if output is below min_output_amount.
not_covered: refund, cancel, recover, and a real AMM venue were not exercised. mock_swap is a 1:1 transfer stand-in, disclosed as such.
